comment: Golden render fixtures (tests/e2e/golden.spec.ts). Each builds a project from test media and renders one frame; tests/golden/<name>.png is the reference. Times and lengths are frames at 30 fps; transforms use project pixels.

fixtures.name: fit-video
fixtures.about: A 1080p video frame fitted to the frame: Y'CbCr to RGB and downscaling.

fixtures.name: fit-portrait
fixtures.about: A 16:9 still in a 9:16 project: letterboxed, never stretched.

fixtures.name: transform
fixtures.about: Scale, rotation and position over a video background.

fixtures.name: anchor
fixtures.about: Rotation about a corner anchor, over a video stretched unevenly about its centre.

fixtures.name: crop
fixtures.about: Cropped edges hide the picture without moving the rest.

fixtures.name: opacity
fixtures.about: Half opacity, blended in linear light.

fixtures.name: alpha
fixtures.about: A still with a soft alpha ramp, scaled and rotated over video (premultiplied alpha).
